---
title: "Penguins"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    Count      = n(),
    avg_depth  = mean(bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_mass   = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
